TREE: taken from the site's own two authoritative sources and cross-checked. THERE IS NO BADKAMER / SALLE DE BAINS / SANITAIR DEPARTMENT AND NO BATHROOM LEAF ANYWHERE. Juttu is Colruyt Group's fashion-and-lifestyle chain on AEM + Fredhopper: clothing, accessories, gifts, food, personal care and home deco. QTY: the product lister is a Hypernova/React component whose server-rendered markup ships empty, so the count comes from the storefront's OWN lister payload - the dehydrated React-Query state that the PLP itself hydrates from, carrying "totalPages":T,"itemCount":N alongside the items array, produced by the Fredhopper search service the page declares at /api/aem/search.
